lines.l: When I'm in love with somebody else You expect me to be true
And to keep on loving you Though I'm feeling blue
You think I can't forget you
You'll want me to want you
And though you don't want me now
Until someday you'll want me to want you
When I'm strong for somebody new
Although you don't want me now
I'll get along somehow and then I won't, I won't want you.
